page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.2xlarge is a KVM-hypervised server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per core.

This server is equipped with 1919 GB of local SSD storage, making it suitable for applications requiring fast local read and write access. It also provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, supporting stable data transfer rates across cloud environments. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i5.2xlarge balances dedicated compute resources with a high-capacity local SSD and a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. This resource density makes it a viable option for workloads that require a combination of memory capacity and fast local storage without the overhead of larger instance classes. Suitable workloads include relational databases, NoSQL data stores, caching layers, and localized data processing tasks.
